args.message: I can't give a daily breakdown from monthly_rev because the table only has monthly totals. Each row is one month, dated the first of the month, so there's no daily detail to split January 2025 into. When I asked for a daily breakdown, the query was rejected: the data is already grouped by month and can't be split into days. To get daily January 2025 revenue, I'd need to query the underlying orders data at day level instead.
